title: Gravity Graffiti

screens.name: Stage Select
screens.purpose: Choose an unlocked authored delivery stage and inspect best stars/paint record.
feedback: best stars and paint record remain readable
edge_cases: locked challenge stage cannot block basic progression

interactions.feedback: selected card confirms then gameplay opens
interactions.state_change: load selected authored stage into planning
interactions.invalid_input: locked card remains blocked and shows unlock requirement

implementation_notes: Stage data is authored content; do not infer procedural topology.

screens.name: Gameplay
screens.purpose: Plan and actively paint/repaint cardinal gravity on city surfaces while courier traverses hazards to destination.
feedback: Damage identifies hit source, decrements integrity, freezes then respawns after 0.7s at latest checkpoint/start while painted vectors and spent paint persist.
Pursuer patrol/chase cues are distinct; chase returns after 2s unobstructed sight loss.
Success freezes dangerous simulation before result.
edge_cases: Only first world pointer owns painting; additional world pointers ignored.
Repaint costs one paint exactly like first valid commit.
Retained momentum must remain readable; camera keeps courier and current puzzle zone visible.
Moving hazards and pursuer must never obscure paintable topology.

interactions.feedback: candidate arrow previews during drag; commit locks arrow, pulses zone and cues gravity; courier motion makes commit→gravity→movement causality visible
interactions.precondition: planning or active; paint > 0; touch-down is a paintable zone
interactions.state_change: if drag passes minimum distance, resolve dominant cardinal axis allowed by zone, set/replace vector, consume 1 paint; first valid commit moves planning→active
interactions.invalid_input: short stroke or non-paintable/blocked target consumes 0 paint and snaps preview away

interactions.feedback: pause overlay appears and world motion stops
interactions.state_change: enter paused; freeze movement and timers

interactions.decision_note: Concrete resume target closes pause UX without changing pause semantics.

interactions.state_change: reset authored stage: integrity=3, paint=initial, vectors/hazards reset
interactions.invalid_input: ignored while reset is already executing

state_variants.name: Zero Paint

implementation_notes: World boxes describe interaction/UI territory, not authored collision geometry.

screens.name: Success Result
screens.purpose: Show delivery success, earned stars and next/replay/select choices.
feedback: Stars: completion 1 + integrity>=1 bonus 1 + paint<=par bonus 1.
edge_cases: Optional star challenge unlocks never block basic next-stage progression.

interactions.state_change: next loads next unlocked stage; replay resets current; select returns S1

screens.name: Failure Result
screens.purpose: Explain integrity failure and offer Retry or Stage Select.
edge_cases: Retry clears painted vectors and restores full paint/integrity.

interactions.state_change: retry restores full authored initial stage; select returns S1

input_map.cancel: short/blocked stroke returns preview and costs zero
input_map.conflict: first world pointer wins; UI touch does not paint

input_map.cancel: no state change outside valid control
input_map.conflict: explicit UI hit areas outrank world paint start
input_map.decision_note: Input priority prevents UI/world conflict without changing game rules.

edge_cases: checkpoint respawn preserves committed vectors and consumed paint
full Retry restores integrity=3/full paint/clear vectors and authored hazards
pause freezes courier, hazards, pursuer and timers
destination contact wins immediately and freezes danger simulation
pack_markdown:
# Gravity Graffiti — Interaction Wireframe Pack v0.3

Fun promise: 그린 화살표가 즉시 중력을 바꾸고 길 아이디어를 물리적 움직임으로 만든다.

Screens: S1 Stage Select → S2 Gameplay → S3 Success Result / S4 Failure Result. Gameplay covers Planning, Active, Paused, damage/respawn/checkpoint, zero-paint and pursuer states. The core direct manipulation is a directional drag beginning on a paintable surface; valid cardinal commit consumes one paint and immediately exposes vector→gravity→courier movement causality. Invalid/short/blocked strokes cost zero. Checkpoint recovery preserves stage paint decisions; full Retry restores authored initial state. No implementation node/script architecture is prescribed.

global_ui_rules.touch_rule: First world pointer owns painting; utility UI retains explicit hit areas.
global_ui_rules.decision_note: Layout hierarchy exposes authored rules without changing them.
global_ui_rules.world_priority: Topology, paintable surfaces, hazards, goal and current gravity must read before decoration.

developer_handoff.fun_promise: 그린 화살표가 즉시 중력을 바꾸고 길 아이디어를 물리적 움직임으로 만든다.
developer_handoff.semantic_layer: Use interaction_semantics only as player-experience meaning; do not infer Godot node/script structure.
developer_handoff.responsibility_boundary: Wireframe defines observable UX/state/interaction semantics; implementation architecture and reusable Godot parts are chosen downstream.

acceptance_criteria: S1 Stage Select, S2 Gameplay, S3 Success Result and S4 Failure Result all exist and are reachable by declared guards.
Gameplay exposes planning/active/paused plus hit/respawn/delivered feedback paths.
Valid paint/repaint consumes exactly 1 paint; invalid or short stroke consumes 0.
Painting is available only on paintable zones in planning/active, with first-pointer ownership and cardinal resolution.
Checkpoint recovery after 0.7s preserves painted vectors and spent paint; Retry resets integrity=3, full paint, vectors and hazards.
Destination contact produces success; integrity 0 produces failure.
Pause freezes all movement/timers including pursuer.
Stars preserve completion + integrity>=1 + paint<=par meanings.
Static/repaint/moving-hazard/pursuit content variants fit the same gameplay screen without inventing new rules.
All interaction_semantics component references resolve within S2.
primary_interaction: Directional drag로 도시 표면의 4방향 gravity vector를 paint/repaint.
interaction_principles: Directly paint gravity on readable city surfaces
Keep authored topology/hazards/goal readable over decoration
Do not turn gesture tolerance into difficulty
